[Question]
Before Xiao Lin checks, how many lions does he guess need a check-up?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Before Xiao Lin checks, he guesses that 45 lions need a check-up.
B. Before Xiao Lin checks, he guesses that 50 lions need a check-up.
C. Before Xiao Lin checks, he guesses that 20 lions need a check-up.
D. Before Xiao Lin checks, he guesses that 49 lions need a check-up.
